item.title: Who could replace Jensen Huang? A highly unscientific list of possible successors
item.dc:creator: Connie Loizos
item.description: Nvidia has no succession plan and a CEO in hot water, so we’ve drafted a shortlist.

item.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline

item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling

item.title: Jensen Huang accused of having another affair — with an Nvidia exec
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: Jensen Huang, who has come under fire for admitting to an affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese intelligence agent, has been accused of having a separate affair with an Nvidia subordinate.

item.title: Why the data center you dread might never even be built
item.dc:creator: Theresa Loconsolo, Rebecca Bellan, Tim De Chant
item.description: The data center boom is running into serious real-world obstacles, from widespread local opposition and permitting delays to a scramble for electricity. Before those challenges even come into play, though, there’s a more basic problem: A lot of the projects being announced may never get built in the first place. With billions of dollars in AI infrastructure […]

item.title: Meta is losing its longtime head of infrastructure
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: Santosh Janardhan, who originally joined the company in 2009, will be stepping down from his role.

item.title: Olaf Sakkers is betting he can beat the emerging-manager squeeze
item.dc:creator: Connie Loizos
item.description: Entering into the world of venture capital has never been easy, especially as a first-time fund manager. But it's especially daunting right now. Olaf Sakkers has spent the past five years proving that difficult doesn't mean impossible.

item.title: CoreWeave turns to customer prepayments, shorter contracts to fund AI growth
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: CoreWeave is increasingly asking customers to pay up front, borrowing against specific contracts, and even looking to short-term deals that could lead to higher prices, according to the company’s third-quarter earnings.

item.title: With $720M round, Britain’s Fractile gets a leg up in the race for AI chips
item.dc:creator: Anna Heim
item.description: Fractile has now become one of the top-funded players in the race for purpose-built AI chips.

item.title: Congress to call Jensen Huang in to answer for alleged Chinese spy affair
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has until the end of the day Wednesday to answer a call from House Republicans for a closed-door briefing on his affair with alleged Chinese spy.

item.title: Is Jensen Huang’s bad behavior more commonplace than it seems?
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: “There are a lot of senior people in the industry that know this is happening, and are effectively condoning it,” an investment intel consultant said.

item.title: OpenAI’s quarterly revenue reportedly crosses $10B for the first time
item.dc:creator: Ram Iyer
item.description: Sales of $10 billion represents an almost 50% jump from revenue of $6.7 billion the company recorded in the second quarter.

item.title: Siri co-founder backs Helix for its voice ID tech
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: With the rise of AI agents like Instinct and Muse, the industry needs to rethink human identity on the internet and rely on biometric signals like voice, which is where Helix comes in.

item.title: Databricks’ new AI agent tells CEO Ali Ghodsi the unvarnished truth
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: With Databricks at 12,000 employees, AI Ghodsi is the first to admit that he can't know everyone and that they are unlikely to confess the things that go wrong to him. But he doesn't need them to. He uses Databricks' newly revised Genie agent for that.

item.title: Plurai wants to help AI agents work better using the same approach that helped get self-driving cars to roads
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: Like the end-to-end models trained to drive cars, AI agents are probabilistic systems operating in unpredictable environments.

item.title: Nvidia’s crisis has corporate governance experts reaching for the popcorn
item.dc:creator: Connie Loizos
item.description: The governance experts we talked to say nobody has seen anything like what's unfolding right now.

item.title: X launches its own clipping feature to spur influencer engagement
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: X is jumping into clipping, the popular practice of cutting long videos into short, shareable clips that can go viral.

item.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.

item.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.

item.title: Proximal Ventures raises debut fund to back startups bringing AI to drug development
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
